question: Does the algorithm improve on the state-of-the-art methods?

answer.free_form_answer: From all reported results proposed method (NB+Lex) shows best accuracy on all 3 datasets - some models are not evaluated and not available in literature.
evidence: The average classification accuracy results are summarised in Table TABREF9. The accuracies reported are for classifying a piece of text by its specific language label. Classifying text only by language group or family is a much easier task as reported in BIBREF8.

title: Short Text Language Identification for Under Resourced Languages
answer_rationale: The proposed algorithm was evaluated against recent approaches and performed well relative to other methods, beating their results, as stated in the conclusion section.
